queue.title: Engagement probe JS bundle follow-up
queue.description: (added ~s699): Current engagement-surface-probe only scans the initial HTML response. SPAs that lazy-load JS bundles may hide API routes in chunk files. A follow-up could extract `<script src="...">` URLs from the HTML, fetch the top 2-3 JS bundles, and scan those for API patterns too. Would improve detection for React/Next.js SPAs where the HTML is just a shell.

outcome.note: Already implemented as part of wq-1061. extractScriptUrls, prioritizeBundles, and scanJsBundles all present and working — confirmed via dry-run probe that found moltyscan signals only in JS bundle.
